reviews.title: It ain’t bad
reviews.text: I’m about 53 days into using SnapCal, and I’ve really been enjoying it. I haven’t seen a huge change in weight or body fat yet, but honestly, that’s not the biggest reason I like the app. It gives me a way to stay accountable, stay focused, and feel like I’m working toward a goal every day. One feature I’d love to see in the future is the option to track calorie or intake goals on a weekly or even monthly basis instead of only looking at a daily target. I think being able to see a weekly “budget” would give users a little more flexibility and variety while still keeping them accountable overall. Having daily, weekly, and monthly views or goals would make an already great app even better.

reviews.title: Stopped allowing me to search for food items
reviews.text: This app worked well for the first few days, albeit be with the inaccuracy of calorie estimations others have identified. Then, each time I tried to add a food item and used the search feature, I got a pop-up asking me to sign up for the $36.99 yearly plan, which I had already purchased. I was able to enter water and any item I had used in the past, but not any new foods. I did go to the App Store and update the app as had been suggested in a prior review, with no improvement. I have submitted a Help request but received no response.
